description_en: Associates shared resources or principals with a resource share
description_zh: 为共享单元关联共享资源或资源使用者
name: AssociateResourceShare

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

`Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be specified together
fields.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

Resources.N.ResourceId与Resources.N.ResourceType成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

You can specify up to five resources in a single request.

For a list of supported resource types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html.

`Resources.N.ResourceId` and `Resources.N.ResourceType` must be specified together
fields.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html。

`Resources.N.ResourceId`与`Resources.N.ResourceType`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resources to associate with the resource share
parameters.name: resources

parameters.help_en: The principals to associate with the resource share
parameters.name: targets

parameters.help_en:
The ARNs of the shared resources.

You can specify up to five resources in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多添加5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

parameters.help_en: The names of the permissions to apply. If this parameter is omitted, the system automatically applies the default permission for the resource type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.help_zh: 共享权限名称。为空时，系统自动绑定资源类型关联的默认权限。具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.name: permission_names

fields.help_en:
The property of the principal. For example, you can specify the time period for resource sharing. Valid values for `timeRangeType` are:

`timeRange`: a specific period of time.

`day`: an entire day.

`TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` must be specified together
fields.help_zh:
资源使用者属性参数。例如：您可以设置资源共享的时间段。`timeRangeType`取值：
timeRange：指定时间段。
day：全天。
`TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: property

fields.help_en:
The ID of the principal.

`TargetProperties.N.TargetId` and `TargetProperties.N.Property` must be specified together
fields.help_zh:
资源使用者ID。

`TargetProperties.N.TargetId`与`TargetProperties.N.Property`成对出现，需要同时设置
fields.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the principals.

This parameter applies only when a principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者属性。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时可以设置该参数
parameters.name: target_properties

ResourceShareAssociations.description_en: The information about the resources or principals that are associated with the resource share
ResourceShareAssociations.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

items.description_en: The information about a resource or principal that is associated with the resource share
items.description_zh: 共享单元关联的共享资源或资源使用者信息

AssociationStatus.description_zh:
关联状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。
Associated：已关联。
Failed：关联失败。
Disassociating：分离中。
Disassociated：已分离。

`Failed`和`Disassociated`状态的记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除

AssociationStatusMessage.description_en: The reason why the association failed
AssociationStatusMessage.example: The reason for the association failure.

AssociationType.description_zh:
关联类型。取值：

Resource：资源。
Target：资源使用者

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the association was created. This parameter can be one of the following values:

If `AssociationType` is set to `Resource`, this parameter indicates the time when the resource was added.

If `AssociationType` is set to `Target`, this parameter indicates the time when the principal was added
CreateTime.description_zh:
关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为添加资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为添加资源使用者的时间

EntityId.description_en:
The ID of the associated entity. This parameter can be one of the following values:

If `AssociationType` is set to `Resource`, this parameter indicates the ID of the resource.

If `AssociationType` is set to `Target`, this parameter indicates the ID of the principal
EntityId.description_zh:
关联实体ID。取值：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为资源ID。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target` 时，该参数为资源使用者ID

EntityType.description_en:
The type of the associated entity. Valid values:

If the associated entity is a resource, the value is the resource type. For more information, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）.

If the associated entity is a principal, the value is `Account`
EntityType.description_zh:
关联实体类型。取值：

当关联实体为资源时，该参数为资源类型。更多信息，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）。
当关联实体为资源使用者时，该参数为`Account`

ResourceArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the associated resource.

This parameter is returned only when `AssociationType` is set to `Resource`
ResourceArn.description_zh:
关联资源ARN。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数不可用

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

TargetProperty.description_en:
The properties of the principal. For example, the time range for resource sharing.

This parameter is returned only if the principal is an Alibaba Cloud service
TargetProperty.description_zh:
资源使用者属性。例如：资源共享的时间段。
仅当资源使用者为阿里云服务时返回设置该参数

UpdateTime.description_en:
The time when the association was updated. This parameter can be one of the following values:

If `AssociationType` is set to `Resource`, this parameter indicates the time when the resource was updated.

If `AssociationType` is set to `Target`, this parameter indicates the time when the principal was updated
UpdateTime.description_zh:
更新关联的时间。存在以下两种情况：

当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源`Resource`时，该参数为更新资源的时间。
当关联类型`AssociationType`为资源使用者`Target`时，该参数为更新资源使用者的时间
